ABOUT ME

Built one idea
at a time.

Kokonut is where I build software and try out hardware ideas. Right now, I’m working on three Android apps: making plans with friends, keeping a food journal, and finding your way through difficult coursework.

Then there’s the pedal. A hardware experiment to take Windows VST plug-ins from a DAW to a live guitar rig. Still an idea, with a lot to figure out.

A QUICK NOTE

First time with an APK?

These are Android test builds. They won’t install on an iPhone or iPad.

How do I install an app?+

Read the app’s setup notes, then download its APK. Open the file from Downloads. Android may ask you to allow installation from your browser or Files. Follow the device’s guidance, install the app, and turn off the source permission afterwards.

Android won’t install the file+

Check the minimum Android version and available storage. Re-download if the file is incomplete. Managed devices and protection settings can restrict installation. Keep Play Protect enabled and follow Android’s installation guidance.

I have an older test build+

A compatible build normally installs as an update. A different signing certificate may prevent that. Back up or export your data before removing an app: uninstalling can erase local food logs, files and settings.
